description.value: The Best Western Plus Sands is an eco-certified, six-storey hotel on Davie Street in Vancouver's West End, marketed on its booking page as having 'retro flair' and access to ocean breezes and city attractions. The property offers professional meeting rooms and reliable internet access. Its location in a dense, walkable neighbourhood puts guests within easy reach of English Bay and Vancouver's urban cycling network.
